text:
mira: FYI I pushed a tiny Next.js starter + eval harness that shows SDK parity (browser proxy vs server-side), plus a LangChain/LlamaIndex minimal compare for onboarding.
sam: sweet. can you paste the browser proxy pattern? SSR folks always trip on this.
mira: proxy snippet: `GET /api/proxy?to=/v1/generate` -> reads httpOnly session cookie, rotates ephemeral token, forwards with Authorization header.

jon: did you guard against double-retry on 401? we saw recursive refresh attempts before.
mira: yes, pinning SDK v0.9 and added header guard: `if (req.headers['x-retry']>1) return 401`.

leslie: eval harness details? CI will run it on PRs right?
mira: small eval: 3 prompt templates in e2e/prompts.json; compare outputs from local quantized llama vs hosted redwood model. `yarn workspace @redwood/eval run --prompts=e2e/prompts.json --target=hosted --retries=1`.

sam: add troubleshooting section: cookie vs localStorage, retry loops, CI flake, model timeouts. new hires will thank you.

ci-bot: lightweight eval job attached to PRs: 3 prompts, 25s per prompt, 1 retry. will post summary to PR.
mira: PR with README, short gif, and checklist incoming. will ping #devex when merged. :rocket:
